description: This Java class implements a CoAP transport health checker for monitoring purposes, utilizing the Californium CoAP library to send test payloads and manage the CoAP client lifecycle.

classes.name: CoapTransportHealthChecker
classes.description: A class that checks the health of a CoAP transport by sending test payloads and managing the CoAP client lifecycle.

methods.name: initClient
methods.description: Initializes the CoAP client with the target URI and timeout settings.

methods.name: sendTestPayload
methods.description: Sends a test payload via CoAP POST and verifies the success response.

methods.name: destroyClient
methods.description: Shuts down and cleans up the CoAP client.

methods.name: getTransportType
methods.description: Returns the transport type, which is COAP.
